- [Samsung India](../brands/samsung.md) · disclosed collaboration. The captions use #Collaboration and promote Galaxy devices or Smart Switch.
- [Lenovo Legion India](../brands/lenovo.md) · disclosed collaboration. Caption disclosure and an Instagram co-author field identify Lenovo Legion India.
- [Amazon India](../brands/amazon.md) · coauthored. Amazon News India co-authored a Great Indian Festival promotional Reel. Other brands listed in the offer are product mentions.
- [Amazon India](../brands/amazon.md) · retailer mentioned. Amazon is named as the retailer in this Samsung offer.
- [YouTube India](../brands/youtube.md) · coauthored. YouTube India published the carousel with GamerFleet as a co-author.
- [Joy Beautiful By Nature](../brands/joy.md) · product integration. The caption tags Joy and describes its skincare in a sibling setup.
- [Pokémon](../brands/pokemon.md) · event association. The posts reference Pokémon and the event. The September 3 carousel thanks Pokémon.
- [Porsche](../brands/porsche.md) · mentioned. Captions tag Porsche in automotive or lifestyle content.
- [Mercedes](../brands/mercedes.md) · mentioned. Caption hashtag on a separate Reels-tab discovery.
- [Saregama](../brands/saregama.md) · credited. The carousel credits Saregama for music.
